summary: Trimble Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders, including election of directors, advisory vote on executive compensation, ratification of auditor KPMG, and approval of ESPP amendments. The filing also discloses the resignation of director Mark S. Peek prior to the meeting, with no disagreement cited, and the appointment of Thomas Sweet as Audit Committee Chair. This is a routine current report of shareholder votes and a governance change, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or restructuring events disclosed.
